identity.headline: One job in. One inspectable result out.
identity.explanation: Clervo is designed to route a bounded job across models, data, and runtime, then return the result with evidence, cost, and a receipt.

products.label: Research
allowedClaims: Raw cited Search is publicly callable through a bounded free sample and an exact 0.006 USDC Base x402 offer.
The production edge returned live normalized results and citations while direct product access to the origin remained denied.
The production Search path returned one useful cited result after one bounded 0.006 USDC owner-funded x402 settlement.
An exact replay returned the same receipt without another authorization, execution, or charge.

products.label: AI
allowedClaims: The frozen public AI catalog contains 85 canonical models and 4 stable aliases; 88 of 89 callable IDs are currently sellable.
Qualified AI requests expose exact request-derived Base USDC x402 quotes through the protected production edge.
Two bounded owner-funded production operations—ai.chat at 0.001 USDC and ai.image at 0.0255 USDC—returned useful exact-model results and settled for exactly 0.0265 USDC total with zero supplier cost.
Both paid operations replayed with the same operation, result, and receipt without another payment header, authorization, upstream execution, settlement, or charge.
Only currently qualified exact routes are eligible; unsupported or expired routes fail closed.
prohibitedClaims: Every catalogued model is currently sellable
Every AI modality has a paid-result proof
Unrelated-customer demand or externally repeated proof

products.label: Secure Sandbox
allowedClaims: Bounded one-shot Node.js execution is publicly callable through class-derived 0.010 to 0.060 USDC Base x402 offers.
The first 0.010 USDC owner-funded SHORT attempt settled and cleaned up but was rejected as a finished result after the isolated Node process exited 134 with empty output.

After the qualified runner correction, one 0.010 USDC owner-funded SHORT execution returned the expected useful output in gVisor, replayed without another authorization, execution, settlement, or charge, and left no runtime resources.
The current release is intentionally single-node and fails closed when its bounded capacity is unavailable.
prohibitedClaims: Arbitrary container images or network access

products.label: Multi-chain RPC
allowedClaims: The RPC core is privately qualified.

products.label: Prediction Intelligence
allowedClaims: Derived Prediction Intelligence is publicly callable through exact Base USDC x402 offers from 0.002 to 0.003 USDC.
Qualified zero-cost pdata supply covers Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, and Limitless with CC BY 4.0 attribution and Clervo transformation.
Direct venue adapters with unresolved commercial permission remain disabled and fail closed.
Two bounded owner-funded production operations each settled for exactly 0.002 USDC, returned useful fresh pdata-attributed results, and replayed without another authorization or charge.
prohibitedClaims: Unrelated-customer demand or externally repeated proof
Raw pdata proxy or raw feed redistribution
Commercial permission for unresolved direct venue adapters

products.label: Crypto Intelligence
allowedClaims: Crypto Intelligence is publicly callable for Ethereum and Base wallet balances, tokens, transactions, flows, counterparties, and deterministic reports through exact Base USDC x402 offers.
Production qualification and funded execution returned fresh hash-bound real-source output on Ethereum and Base with explicit partial/degraded coverage and no fabricated completeness.
Blockscout is used only for a provider-neutral value-added application; no raw API, response, essential service, or credential is resold.
Public prices are 0.002 USDC for balances or tokens, 0.003 for transactions, and 0.004 for the wallet report.

Two bounded owner-funded production operations—crypto.wallet.report at 0.004 USDC and crypto.wallet.transactions at 0.003 USDC—returned useful fresh source-backed results, settled exactly 0.007 USDC total, and replayed with the same operation, result, and receipt without another authorization, upstream execution, settlement, or charge.
prohibitedClaims: Unrelated-customer demand or externally repeated proof
Raw Blockscout API, response, essential-service, RPC, or credential resale

blockrun.reason: No volatile count, price, availability, quality, or savings claim renders until its primary-source observation is current and reviewable.
